headline: The board learned to count tokens
lede: Slot a shipped a live throughput line for the /forge board — tokens/hr per box straight off the servers' own usage counters — and found, diagnosed, and filed the reason the board page itself hasn't loaded in production this week.

notes.text: #1377 shipped (PR #1393): the /forge board now shows `throughput: studio 23.4M/hr · mini 4.9M/hr · mbp 0/hr (n=2)` under SLOTS — trailing-hour tokens/hr per box from cumulative server counters, mean active streams free math. All failure modes degrade honestly: reboot resets walk back to the boot boundary instead of faking a delta, pre-#1299 rows and dead stats endpoints drop their box, stale windows hide the line.

lanecheck 94 -> 105 gates: B5 pins the hour-window math (deltas, reboot guard, span floor, missing-counter schema, freshness, stream-mean honesty) + wiring tripwires. Mutant proof by hand: turning the reboot-break into a continue makes B5c report a nonsense 11,999,850/hr cross-boot rate — that's exactly the number a lying dashboard would show.

The board page /retrogames/forge has been 404ing at the edge since late October: #1131's rewrite for forge sub-path JSON assets also matches the bare page route and sends it to /forge/, which has no server resource. Filed with root cause and fix sketch as #1395 — the throughput line ships to the bundle today; the URL opens when #1395 lands.
